name: Huret
source:
The resident doll maker of Saint-Vailleurs is a calm, laid-back artist of remarkable talent. Though Huret and Julien were once inseparable friends, they rarely see each other now that Julien has joined the Gaultiers at their mansion.

Despite his normally unruffled exterior, Huret is acting restless around Julien... whatever could be causing such a strange shift in demeanor?

[From the [url=https://mordred-f.jimdo.com/]official site[/url]]
